query FlxWikiScreen {
  flxWikiOverview {
    homeUrl
    siteUrl
    base
    llmsUrl
    llmsFullUrl
    searchApi
    mcpEnabled
    mcpTools
    aiInstalled
    aiReady
    guideCount
    publishedCount
    defaultTitle
    defaultIntro
    newPageUrl
  }
  flxSettings {
    wiki {
      ...FlxWikiSettingsFields
    }
  }
  flxWikiSections {
    ...FlxWikiSectionRow
  }
}

fragment FlxWikiSectionRow on FlxWikiSection {
  databaseId
  slug
  name
  description
  order
  pageCount
  url
}

fragment FlxWikiSettingsFields on FlxSettingsWiki {
  enabled
  title
  intro
  base
  aiLinks
  editLink
  accent
  width
  nav
  toc
  ask
  askLimit
}
